text.p: U.S. stocks are expected to open mixed to lower on Monday after a rally on Friday which reached new records on the S&P 500 Index and NYSE Composite Index and left the Dow just 27 points shy of its all-time high.

"I think we are going into a mixed morning. There is nothing dramatic on the news front and bonds are waiting for the supply that will come out of the refunding this week," said Larry Wachtel, analyst at Prudential Securities.
"I see an unfocused day with everyone watching the dollar and waiting for the refunding on Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday."
